xiao2026retoken.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision–Language Models for Visual Retrieval
xiao2026retoken.author: Yao Xiao, Reuben Tan, Zhen Zhu, Yuqun Wu, Jianfeng Gao, Derek Hoiem
xiao2026retoken.tlrd: Attention tells you where a VLM looks, so shouldn't it tell you which frames matter? It doesn't: the retrieval signal lives in the value space, and a single learned token is enough to read it out.

xiao2025textregion.title: TextRegion: Text-Aligned Region Tokens from Frozen Image-Text Models
xiao2025textregion.author: Yao Xiao, Qiqian Fu, Heyi Tao, Yuqun Wu, Zhen Zhu, Derek Hoiem
xiao2025textregion.tlrd: A simple, training-free approach to get region tokens directly comparable to text embeddings, achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot region-level understanding.
